name: Ikawa (Akita, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ikawa town emblem in black: a spiked ring enclosing a small ring, like a cog.
history: Municipal flag of Ikawa, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 December 1959.

features.role: Ikawa town emblem — a spiked ring enclosing a small ring, like a cog
